title: Universality of the lifted algebraic transition
statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition_universal
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A}
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk
      (finitePerfectAdicLiftedTransition T n)))

source.place: Tags 06YY and 09C6, normalized algebraic quotient transition

proof.text: Apply the transpose-isomorphism lemma for the lifted transition to the derived restriction adjunction, then use the adjunction Hom equivalence to identify the transition with the unit followed by the image of an isomorphism.
The unit arrow is initial by the generic structured-arrow construction for a left adjoint. Transport initiality along the structured-arrow isomorphism induced by the invertible transpose.
